title: He Would Not Stop Traveling Until He Found a Teacher

meta.name: v5_k18_08_the-teacher
meta.title: He Would Not Stop Traveling Until He Found a Teacher

lines.text: He wouldn't stop traveling until he found a teacher.
Mūsā sets out and tells his servant:
I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period.

quran.ar: لَاۤ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰۤ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَیۡنِ أَوۡ أَمۡضِیَ حُقُبࣰا

lines.text: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.

quran.ar: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدࣰا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَاۤ ءَاتَیۡنَـٰهُ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمࣰا

lines.text: Never think you have learned enough.
